title: Chess Placing
statementMd:
You are given a chessboard of size $1 × *n*$. It is guaranteed that **$*n*$ is even**. The chessboard is painted like this: "`BWBW`$...$`BW`".

Some cells of the board are occupied by the chess pieces. Each cell contains no more than one chess piece. It is known that the total number of pieces equals to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png).

In one step you can move one of the pieces one cell to the left or to the right. You cannot move pieces beyond the borders of the board. You also cannot move pieces to the cells that are already occupied.

Your task is to place all the pieces in the cells of the same color **using the minimum number of moves** (all the pieces must occupy only the black cells or only the white cells after all the moves are made).

## Input

The first line of the input contains one integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, **$*n*$ is even**) — the size of the chessboard.

The second line of the input contains ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png) integer numbers ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e2af9e0bc529157633221e52aefff46b28281af2.png) ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) — initial positions of the pieces. It is guaranteed that all the positions are distinct.

## Output

Print one integer — **the minimum number of moves** you have to make to place all the pieces in the cells of the same color.

## Note

In the first example the only possible strategy is to move the piece at the position $6$ to the position $5$ and move the piece at the position $2$ to the position $3$. Notice that if you decide to place the pieces in the white cells the minimum number of moves will be $3$.

In the second example the possible strategy is to move ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e1e06f6a15cce30628c7a2360c4ffa57a8ba0ebd.png) in 4 moves, then ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c84dfbe0c6a917b45fc3f69467c256c4ac460eeb.png) in 3 moves, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/598731d81393332209d914cb0bbe97d8566c887d.png) in 2 moves and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png) in 1 move.
statementZhMd:
给定一个大小为 $1 × *n*$ 的棋盘。保证 **$*n*$ 为偶数**。棋盘的涂色方式如下："`BWBW`$...$`BW`"。

棋盘上的一些格子中放置着棋子。每个格子中至多放置一个棋子。已知棋子的总数等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png)。

在一步操作中，你可以将一个棋子向左或向右移动一个格子。不能将棋子移出棋盘边界，也不能将棋子移动到已经被占据的格子中。

你的任务是用**最少的移动次数**，将所有棋子放置到颜色相同的格子中（完成所有移动后，所有棋子必须只占据黑色格子或只占据白色格子）。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$，**$*n*$ 为偶数**）——棋盘的大小。

输入的第二行包含 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png) 个整数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e2af9e0bc529157633221e52aefff46b28281af2.png)（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n$）——棋子的初始位置。保证所有位置互不相同。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——将所有棋子放置到颜色相同的格子中所需的最少移动次数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，唯一可行的策略是将位置 $6$ 的棋子移动到位置 $5$，并将位置 $2$ 的棋子移动到位置 $3$。注意，如果决定将棋子放置在白色格子中，最少需要移动 $3$ 次。

在第二个样例中，一种可行的策略是将 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e1e06f6a15cce30628c7a2360c4ffa57a8ba0ebd.png) 移动 $4$ 次，然后将 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c84dfbe0c6a917b45fc3f69467c256c4ac460eeb.png) 移动 $3$ 次，将 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/598731d81393332209d914cb0bbe97d8566c887d.png) 移动 $2$ 次，最后将 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png) 移动 $1$ 次。
